eligibility: Public small-to-medium scalar regression material datasets with explicit composition and source metadata; none is a built-in example. Includes experimental and DFT labels.
model_policy: Existing 6 default regressors, 3 feature recipes, existing 4-trial nested optimization. No changes after holdout evaluation.
features: Existing steel representation: element fractions + seven periodic-table summaries. Any dataset conditions are included only when observed and defined before fitting.

columns.a_1: Species occupying the a1 perovskite site
columns.gap gllbsc: electronic band gap (in eV) calculated via gllbsc

double_perovskites_gap.description: Band gap of 1306 double perovskites (a_1-b_1-a_2-b_2-O6) calculated using ﻿Gritsenko, van Leeuwen, van Lenthe and Baerends potential (gllbsc) in GPAW.

columns.formula: Chemical formula of the dataset entry
columns.k_condition_units: units of testing condition temperature representation
columns.k_expt: the experimentally measured thermal conductivity in SI units of W/m.K

citrine_thermal_conductivity.description: Thermal conductivity of 872 compounds measured experimentally and retrieved from Citrine database from various references. The reported values are measured at various temperatures of which 295 are at room temperature.

preprocessing_policy: Use original recorded site elements or temperature context. Identical composition+context records aggregate by median, retaining all source rows. Composition groups never cross train/test.
screening_policy: Maximize gap for wide-gap oxide screening; maximize conductivity for heat transport. Budgets 1,3,5; compare exact random expected best. No outcome-dependent reconfiguration.
